claims.object_text: clearance of GABA from the synaptic cleft
claims.quote: plays a pivotal role in synaptic neurotransmission by facilitating the clearance of GABA from the synaptic cleft

claims.object_text: epilepsy, autism spectrum disorder, intellectual disability, developmental delay
claims.quote: Pathogenic mutations in the SLC6A1 gene encoding hGAT-1 have been implicated in a spectrum of neurodevelopmental disorders, including epilepsy, autism spectrum disorder, intellectual disability, and developmental delay
substitutions of G443 to aspartate (G443D) or valine (G443V) result in complete abolishment of GABA transport

claims.object_text: disruptions in protein folding and trafficking
claims.quote: This severe impairment stems from distinct disruptions in protein folding and trafficking
in vivo studies in Drosophila melanogaster
G443V is fully retained in the endoplasmic reticulum (ER)

claims.object_text: partial trafficking to the plasma membrane with reduced expression
claims.quote: The G443D variant, on the other hand, exhibits partial trafficking to the plasma membrane, confirmed by the presence of maturely glycosylated bands, albeit at significantly reduced expression levels relative to the wild type transporter
Treatment with glycerol and 4-phenylbutyrate (4-PBA) successfully restored both surface expression and GABA uptake activity of the G443 mutants
